cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my printer troubleshooting above your restart in the project report. Diagnosis before implementation, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Implementation delivered successfully. Second place. Please don't rank the final button press above identifying the fault.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the fault.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then add stress testing above diagnosis. My menu exposed the limit. Move your restart to third, please, and renumber the report.
